shared_elements: human figure rendered in relief on a stone surface
curved band(s) crossing the body (belt or sash-like)
ornamented headgear or headdress-like element at the top
justification: Both surfaces carry a human-derived form with a disc/ring motif on the torso and curved sash-like bands, plus something headdress-like above, but these are generic body-plus-ornament conventions rather than a shared specific scheme. A is a two-figure narrative in low relief flanked and framed by dense columns of rectangular sign blocks, with a profile figure in elaborate feathered regalia; B is a massive frontal, near-abstract standing statue whose back bears only sparse schematic curvilinear marks and no narrative or sign-block framing.
